webpage.text:
All Bar One in Leeds

About us

All Bar One Greek Street Leeds is a stylish city bar where you can catch up with friends, unwind after work or simply find a sophisticated space to indulge in an excellent selection of food and drink.

Within easy reach of Wellington Street, Park Row and The Headrow, All Bar One Greek Street Leeds is the perfect place to meet up with friends or unwind with work colleagues. Of all the bars in Leeds, we've got the right blend of food, drink and atmosphere at any time of day.

Whether you're looking for the perfect place to celebrate a special occasion, or simply celebrate the end of another working day, you'll always find a glass of the good stuff at All Bar One Greek Street Leeds.

Unwind over your favourite wine from our extensive selection. Not sure what to choose? Browse through our wine library to find your perfect match. If it's drinks with friends, order a bundle of our sharing plates too - ideal for picking over along with the day's affairs.

Our bartenders can mix an impressive range of cocktails, from traditional tipples to new classics, such as our wine cocktails. We've also got premium bottled lagers and beer on tap, and a great range of soft drinks, including our alcohol-free softails.

If you're holding a party for more than eight people, you can now reserve an area online. Turn it into a real occasion with one of our specially selected party packages; choose from a wide range of wines, bottled beers, cocktails - or even some bubbles - to suit.

Reviews


Itohan joy Okunzuwa

Had a solo bottomless brunch here Food was great Drink was a bit slow Over all it was great Recommend

Kellie Ainger

DJ was a fantastic host, I've done a lot of bottomless brunches in Leeds and this is one of the best! Thank you!

Tom Golesworthy

Absolutely superb brunch. Friendly, attentive and efficient staff who kept our drinks topped up. Food was delicious and a fab selection. Would definitely recommend for anyone wishing to have brunch in Leeds.

Tayler Ingleby

We had a bottomless brunch this weekend! Wow amazing! One of the best bottomless brunches I’ve done. DJ our server was amazing, he was very consistent and made sure our visit easy. Will definitely be back again! The food was also amazing! Xx

Julie Kent

Had a Birthday night out last night and enjoyed a delicious Tapas Selection at All Bar One, Greek Street, Leeds. The tapas selection was very tasty and very reasonable priced. We also had a bottle of red wine which was extremely good - ‘Smooth Talker’ Merlot. We were served by the host called ‘Dais’ and she was very efficient with a very pleasant manner. Our food was served very quickly and Dais made sure we had everything we needed. All in all it was an excellent night out with tasty food and drink at a good price and all served by a lovely host. Highly Recommended *****
